title: The Summer Fair at the Bottom of the Well
description: At the last fair of summer, riders in painted thimbles rise into a shaft of sunlight. Below, the well water catches every turn of the brass wheel.
alt: Tiny fairgoers ride painted thimble gondolas on a brass Ferris wheel inside a mossy stone well. Sunlight from the opening catches the wheel above blue water.
pairing: An imagined end-of-summer fair × a miniature Ferris wheel inside a well
